<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Read up to 50 messages by ref. Each ref succeeds or fails on its own.

--full keeps quoted text and signatures and does not cut the body at body\_limit. --raw writes one message's original bytes, and refuses a terminal.

## Usage

```text
chainmail get <ref>... [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail get cm1:work:INBOX:7:42
chainmail get --full cm1:work:INBOX:7:42
chainmail get --raw cm1:work:INBOX:7:42 > message.eml
```

## Flags

```text
      --full   keep quoted text and signatures, and do not cut at body_limit
      --raw    write the original RFC 5322 bytes of one message to stdout, which must not be a terminal
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
